parameters.query:
INSERT INTO sources (
  platform,
  kind,
  normalized_key,
  name,
  slug,
  external_id,
  canonical_url,
  feed_url,
  state,
  monitoring_mode,
  relevance_score,
  confidence,
  discovered_by_query,
  first_seen_at,
  last_seen_at,
  last_scanned_at,
  last_successful_run_at,
  source_metadata
)
VALUES (
  'reddit',
  'subreddit',
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  $4,
  $5,
  $6,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER($7) = 'evergreen' THEN 'evergreen'::source_state
    WHEN LOWER($7) = 'validated' THEN 'validated'::source_state
    WHEN LOWER($7) = 'archived' THEN 'archived'::source_state
    ELSE 'candidate'::source_state
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER($8) = 'always scanned' THEN 'always_scanned'::source_monitoring_mode
    WHEN LOWER($8) = 'scanned' THEN 'scanned'::source_monitoring_mode
    WHEN LOWER($8) = 'ignored' THEN 'ignored'::source_monitoring_mode
    ELSE 'monitored'::source_monitoring_mode
  END,
  $9,
  $10,
  $11,
  COALESCE($12::timestamptz, now()),
  COALESCE($13::timestamptz, now()),
  now(),
  now(),
  $14::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (normalized_key)
DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
  external_id = EXCLUDED.external_id,
  canonical_url = EXCLUDED.canonical_url,
  feed_url = EXCLUDED.feed_url,
  state = EXCLUDED.state,
  monitoring_mode = EXCLUDED.monitoring_mode,
  relevance_score = EXCLUDED.relevance_score,
  confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
  discovered_by_query = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.discovered_by_query, sources.discovered_by_query),
  last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at,
  last_scanned_at = now(),
  last_successful_run_at = now(),
  source_metadata = EXCLUDED.source_metadata
RETURNING id, normalized_key;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(slug, ''), NULLIF(external_id, ''), regexp_replace(name, '^r/', '', 'i')) AS subreddit,
  confidence,
  monitoring_mode,
  last_scanned_at
FROM sources
WHERE platform = 'reddit'
  AND is_active = true
  AND state IN ('validated', 'evergreen')
  AND monitoring_mode IN ('scanned', 'always_scanned')
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN monitoring_mode = 'always_scanned' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  confidence DESC,
  last_scanned_at NULLS FIRST;

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb) AS source_record_key
),
matches AS (
  SELECT o.source_record_key
  FROM opportunities o
  JOIN incoming i ON i.source_record_key = o.source_record_key
)
SELECT
  $2::jsonb AS posts,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(source_record_key) FROM matches), '[]'::jsonb) AS existing_keys;

options.systemMessage:
=You are a strict classifier of Reddit posts.

Task:
For each object in the input array, decide whether it is a real paid employer-side opportunity.

Rules:
- Accept only real employer/client requests.
- Reject freelancer self-promotion.
- Reject discussions, guides, showcases, announcements, and vague speculation.
- Reject unpaid or unclear requests.
- Keep the response short and strict.

Return ONLY valid JSON.
Return exactly one result per input item.

Schema:
[
  {
    "id": "string",
    "is_job": true,
    "confidence": 0,
    "reason": "short explanation"
  }
]

parameters.query:
WITH payload AS (
  SELECT jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS item
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO opportunities (
    source_id,
    platform,
    source_record_key,
    content_fingerprint,
    source_native_id,
    canonical_url,
    title,
    content,
    author_name,
    published_at,
    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at,
    score,
    confidence,
    status,
    routing_action,
    intent,
    is_job,
    ai_reason,
    extracted_entities,
    raw_payload
  )
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT s.id
      FROM sources s
      WHERE s.normalized_key = item->>'source_normalized_key'
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    'reddit',
    item->>'source_record_key',
    md5(COALESCE(item->>'title', '') || '|' || COALESCE(item->>'text', '')),
    NULLIF(item->>'source_native_id', ''),
    item->>'canonical_url',
    item->>'title',
    COALESCE(item->>'content', ''),
    NULLIF(item->>'author_name', ''),
    CASE WHEN NULLIF(item->>'published_at', '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (item->>'published_at')::timestamptz END,
    now(),
    now(),
    COALESCE((item->>'job_score')::int, 0),
    COALESCE((item->>'confidence')::int, 0),
    'new',
    CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(item->>'routing_action', 'review')) = 'telegram' THEN 'telegram'::opportunity_routing_action ELSE 'review'::opportunity_routing_action END,
    'job',
    NULL,
    COALESCE(item->>'heuristic_reason', NULL),
    '{}'::jsonb,
    COALESCE(item->'raw_payload', '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM payload
  ON CONFLICT (source_record_key)
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_seen_at = now(),
    score = GREATEST(opportunities.score, EXCLUDED.score),
    confidence = GREATEST(opportunities.confidence, EXCLUDED.confidence),
    routing_action = EXCLUDED.routing_action,
    ai_reason = COALESCE(opportunities.ai_reason, EXCLUDED.ai_reason),
    raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload
  RETURNING id, source_record_key
)
INSERT INTO ai_tasks (
  opportunity_id,
  status,
  provider_preference,
  priority,
  payload
)
SELECT
  u.id,
  'pending',
  'local',
  100,
  p.item
FROM upserted u
JOIN payload p ON p.item->>'source_record_key' = u.source_record_key
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
RETURNING opportunity_id;

INSERT INTO opportunities (
  source_id,
  platform,
  source_record_key,
  content_fingerprint,
  source_native_id,
  canonical_url,
  title,
  content,
  author_name,
  published_at,
  first_seen_at,
  last_seen_at,
  score,
  confidence,
  status,
  routing_action,
  intent,
  is_job,
  ai_reason,
  extracted_entities,
  raw_payload
)
VALUES (
  (
    SELECT id
    FROM sources
    WHERE normalized_key = $1
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  'reddit',
  $2,
  md5(COALESCE($3, '') || '|' || COALESCE($4, '')),
  $5,
  $6,
  $7,
  $8,
  $9,
  COALESCE($10::timestamptz, now()),
  now(),
  now(),
  $11,
  $12,
  'new',
  CASE
    WHEN LOWER($13) = 'telegram' THEN 'telegram'::opportunity_routing_action
    ELSE 'review'::opportunity_routing_action
  END,
  'job',
  true,
  $14,
  '{}'::jsonb,
  $15::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (source_record_key)
DO UPDATE SET
  last_seen_at = now(),
  score = GREATEST(opportunities.score, EXCLUDED.score),
  confidence = GREATEST(opportunities.confidence, EXCLUDED.confidence),
  routing_action = EXCLUDED.routing_action,
  ai_reason = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ai_reason, opportunities.ai_reason),
  raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload
RETURNING id, source_record_key, routing_action;
